name: lan-agent
call: <task in plain language> (e.g. Store ~/Videos/movie.mp4 on the file server)
purpose: Stores and retrieves files on a LAN file server over SSH and rsync, using that server's disk instead of the laptop's. Runs ssh/rsync from bash, so the default call is a plain-language task in a chat turn; `/ask` has no tools and cannot reach the server. `/storage <sub>` is the deterministic shell-out: config · use --host --root · check · df · ls · put · get · sync · rm. Its server address and folder live in `config/storage.json` and are expected to change — `REPLACE_` values count as unset and it reports them instead of guessing. Also hands over the first-time setup runbook (key generation, server user, authorized_keys, data disk, sshd hardening, firewall).

commands.name: /storage
commands.description: Deterministic, no model turn: /storage config · use --host <ip> --root <dir> · check · df · ls [sub] · put <files> [--to sub] · get <sub> <local> · sync <dir> <sub> · rm <sub> · ssh <cmd>

commands.name: /ask
commands.description: One request, no chat turn, no tools: /ask "question". Text only — cannot reach the server.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Targeted text replacement in one file.
